description: A custom build of lodash library version 3.10.1, including only 'template' and 'escape' functions, with internal utility functions and support for template settings.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Compiles a string into a template function with support for interpolate, escape, and evaluate delimiters.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes HTML characters in a string.

methods.name: attempt
methods.description: Attempts to invoke a function, returning the result or caught error.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns an array of the object's own enumerable property names.

methods.name: keysIn
methods.description: Returns an array of the object's own and inherited enumerable property names.

methods.name: restParam
methods.description: Creates a function that invokes `func` with the `this` binding and arguments from `start` and beyond as an array.
